paragraphs: CODY Systems describes itself as a privately held, woman owned family company selling software and data management, integration and exchange solutions to public safety and public sector agencies. Pathfinder RMS is a records management system the site ties to more than 44 years of public safety work with law enforcement partners. Pathfinder CAD covers agency units in the field and forms the other half of the Pathfinder RMS/CAD system.

The COBRA side of the business integrates and searches data sources across RMS, CAD, Corrections, Intel, ALPR and SAR regardless of vendor. ExpressBridge supplies more than 100 templates for RMS, CAD and other vendors' systems and powers COBRAnet. Listed buyers include police, sheriff, county detectives, campus safety, tribal and state law enforcement, and fish and wildlife agencies.

CODY says over 900 agencies across the country use its solutions. One named user is the Dallas-Fort Worth NTECC, which runs COBRAnet for unified search and warrant confirmation. A news item on the site reports that Tyler Technologies has acquired the company.

quote.text: Over 900 agencies across the country use CODY solutions to help them do their jobs.
